name: agentspec

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/spec packages/parser packages/linter packages/test-runner packages/diff packages/copilot-studio packages/copilot-studio-audit packages/vscode-extension packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/spec packages/parser packages/linter packages/test-runner packages/diff packages/copilot-studio packages/copilot-studio-audit packages/vscode-extension packages/cli --pretty false
scripts.lint:examples: sh -c 'set -e; for file in examples/*.agentspec.yaml; do case "$file" in *.bad.agentspec.yaml) continue;; esac; pnpm agentspec lint "$file"; done'
scripts.validate:examples: sh -c 'set -e; for file in examples/*.agentspec.yaml; do case "$file" in *.bad.agentspec.yaml) continue;; esac; pnpm agentspec validate "$file"; done'
scripts.test:examples: sh -c 'set -e; for file in examples/*.agentspec.yaml; do case "$file" in *.bad.agentspec.yaml) continue;; esac; pnpm agentspec test "$file"; done'

description: Open-source specification, linter and test framework for AI agent instructions.
